tr: Araba almaya gücü yetmez, lüks olanı hiç alamaz.
en: He can't afford a car, much less a luxury one.

tr: Temelleri bile anlamıyorlar, ileri konuları hiç anlayamazlar.
en: They don't understand the basics, much less the advanced topics.
Apart from English, she also speaks German.
Apart from a few mistakes, the presentation was excellent.

tr: Ders çalışmanın dışında yarı zamanlı çalışıyor.
en: Apart from studying, he also works part-time.
Apart from John, everyone attended the meeting.
She got behind with her studies during the holiday.

tr: İyi plan yapmazsan görevlerinde geri kalabilirsin.
en: If you don’t plan well, you may get behind with your tasks.
He got behind with his work because he was sick.
The manager will look into the problem.
